policy.youtube: Use official APIs and the official embedded player. Never scrape pages or download video/audio.
policy.open_sources: Prefer official APIs. Respect terms, robots.txt, rate limits, attribution, and item-level licenses.
policy.transcripts: Store full transcript text only when KidQ has permission. Otherwise store availability, source URL, hash, and a short original summary.
policy.approval: No connector or AI model may publish directly. Every item starts in manual review unless an explicit rule rejects it.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.rightsCheck: Apply NASA media usage guidelines and inspect third-party credits per item.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons Action API
sources.rightsCheck: Preserve creator, license URL, attribution, and any share-alike requirements.

sources.name: Openverse API
sources.authentication: OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID and OPENVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET for higher limits
sources.rightsCheck: Openverse aggregates license claims; verify attribution and the source landing page before approval.

sources.name: Internet Archive APIs
sources.authentication: none for public search and metadata
sources.rightsCheck: Availability in the archive does not itself grant reuse rights; require an explicit item-level license.

sources.name: StoryWeaver
sources.rightsCheck: Confirm the current official access method and license terms before implementing automated collection.
